The pronounced non-linear Hall effect with hysteresis in magnetic field confirms finite Berry curvature dipole under injection of spin-polarized electrons, i.e. the topological features for the altermagnetic candidate CrSb.

AI.tldr: 本文实验研究了中心对称交变磁体CrSb中自旋极化电子输运，发现其表现出反常霍尔效应（蝴蝶结型磁滞回线）和非线性霍尔效应，且这些效应依赖于铁磁Ni接触而非非磁性Au接触。研究者将符号反转和磁滞现象归因于体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合作用，证实了CrSb作为交变磁候选材料的拓扑特征。
AI.motivation: 探索中心对称交变磁体CrSb中自旋极化电子输运特性，验证其同时具备交变磁性和拓扑特征。
AI.method: 制备CrSb单晶薄片，分别沉积铁磁Ni接触和非磁性Au接触作为对照组，测量其一阶反常霍尔效应和二阶非线性霍尔效应。
AI.result: Ni接触样品表现出蝴蝶结型磁滞回线的反常霍尔效应及非线性霍尔效应，且霍尔曲线斜率随霍尔条接触构型变化而反转；Au接触样品无上述效应。
AI.conclusion: CrSb中观察到的一阶和二阶霍尔效应源于体态交变自旋劈裂与自旋极化拓扑表面态的联合作用，证实该材料是兼具交变磁性和拓扑特性的候选体系。

title: Magnetotransport Properties of Iron-Based Ladder Compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under High Pressure
summary: The magnetotransport properties of the iron-based ladder compounds BaFe2S3 and BaFe2Se3 under various pressures were investigated. BaFe2S3 had a T^2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a normal magnetoresistance near an insulator-metal transition. Therefore, it had Fermi-liquid-like properties in the normal phase. However, BaFe2Se3 had a T^3/2 dependence in electrical resistivity and a negative magnetoresistance. This suggested that BaFe2Se3 had non-Fermi-liquid properties near the insulator-metal transition. For both materials, the Hall resistivities indicated a hole-dominant magnetic field dependence. During a pressure-induced insulator-metal transition, BaFe2Se3 had a rapid decrease in electrical resistivity above 15 GPa attributed to an isomorphic structural transition previously reported in X-ray diffraction experiments. This transition had a strong impact on the electronic properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了铁基梯形化合物BaFe2S3和BaFe2Se3在压力下的磁输运性质。BaFe2S3在绝缘体-金属转变附近呈现费米液体行为（电阻率T²依赖、正常磁电阻），而BaFe2Se3则表现出非费米液体行为（电阻率T³/²依赖、负磁电阻）。两者的霍尔电阻率均显示空穴主导的磁场依赖。BaFe2Se3在15 GPa以上电阻率急剧下降，归因于同构结构相变。
AI.motivation: 探究铁基梯形化合物BaFe2S3和BaFe2Se3在压力诱导的绝缘体-金属转变过程中的磁输运性质，特别是其正常相中的电子关联行为（费米液体 vs 非费米液体）。
AI.method: 测量两种材料在不同压力下的电阻率、磁电阻和霍尔电阻率，分析其温度依赖关系和磁场依赖关系。
AI.result: BaFe2S3呈现费米液体特性（电阻率T²依赖、正常磁电阻）；BaFe2Se3呈现非费米液体特性（电阻率T³/²依赖、负磁电阻）。两者霍尔电阻均显示空穴主导。BaFe2Se3在15 GPa以上电阻率骤降，对应同构结构相变。
AI.conclusion: 两种同系物在压力下表现出截然不同的电子行为，BaFe2Se3的非费米液体行为及其同构相变对电子性质的强烈影响值得进一步关注。

title: Scaling WaterLily.jl with MPI and an improved geometric multigrid solver
summary: We present recent performance-oriented developments in WaterLily.jl, a scale-resolving incompressible flow solver written in pure Julia that runs seamlessly on CPUs and GPUs of any vendor. Supported by the newly added MPI-based parallelism, strong-scalability tests display a near-ideal linear trend, and weak-scaling efficiency is kept above 85\% before node memory-concurrency contention dominates parallel performance. Inter-node weak scalability is sustained above 96\% with grid size up to 1 billion cells. We further benchmark improvements to the geometric multigrid Poisson solver enabled by an adaptive under-relaxed red-black Gauss--Seidel smoother together with anisotropic coarsening operators.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了WaterLily.jl流体求解器的最新性能优化，包括MPI并行、几何多重网格泊松求解器的改进，实现了近理想的强可扩展性和超过96%的弱可扩展性（网格规模达10亿单元）。
AI.motivation: 提升WaterLily.jl（纯Julia编写的不可压缩流求解器）在CPU/GPU上跨供应商的性能表现，解决大规模并行计算中的可扩展性问题。
AI.method: 1) 新增MPI并行框架实现节点间通信；2) 采用自适应欠松弛红黑高斯-赛德尔平滑器改进几何多重网格泊松求解器；3) 引入各向异性粗化算子提升求解效率。
AI.result: 强可扩展性接近理想线性趋势；弱可扩展性在节点内存竞争主导前保持85%以上；节点间弱可扩展性超过96%，网格规模达10亿单元。
AI.conclusion: WaterLily.jl在多供应商CPU/GPU平台上展现出优异的跨节点并行效率和求解器性能，验证了纯Julia实现大规模CFD计算的可行性。

title: Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties in Doped Fe$_2$VAl within a Bipolar Random Anderson Model
summary: We investigate the thermoelectric and magnetic properties of Si-substituted $n$-type and Ti-substituted $p$-type Heusler alloy Fe$_2$VAl using the bipolar random Anderson model, which has been introduced recently to study antisite-defect effects associated with the sign change of the Seebeck coefficient in thermally quenched Fe$_2$VAl. Based on the electronic states of both $n$-type and $p$-type compounds, with the rigid-band shift of the Fermi energy and a temperature-dependent scattering rate taken into account, we elucidate how antisite defects simultaneously influence thermoelectric transport and local magnetic moments. We find that the magnetic moments are enhanced in $n$-type Fe$_2$VAl, whereas they are suppressed in $p$-type Fe$_2$VAl compared with the undoped compound. These contrasting magnetic responses highlight the impact of antisite spin polarization on thermoelectric properties and demonstrate the crucial role of antisite defects in realizing magneto-thermoelectric functionalities in Heusler-type alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双极随机安德森模型研究了Si取代n型和Ti取代p型Heusler合金Fe₂VAl的热电和磁学性质，揭示了反位缺陷对热电输运和局域磁矩的影响，发现n型和p型掺杂对磁矩具有相反的影响效果。
AI.motivation: 探究Heusler合金Fe₂VAl中反位缺陷如何同时影响热电输运性能和局域磁矩，以理解磁热电功能特性的实现机制。
AI.method: 采用双极随机安德森模型，结合刚带近似移动费米能级和温度依赖的散射率，研究n型和p型掺杂化合物的电子态。
AI.result: n型Fe₂VAl中磁矩增强，p型Fe₂VAl中磁矩抑制，呈现相反磁响应特征。
AI.conclusion: 反位自旋极化对热电性能有显著影响，反位缺陷在实现Heusler合金磁热电功能特性中起关键作用。

title: Force-Isosurface Simulations Probe the Limits of High-Resolution AFM on Three-Dimensional Molecules
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures; Supporting Information: 2 pages, 1 figure
summary: High-resolution atomic force microscopy has transformed molecular imaging by revealing intramolecular structure directly in real space. A major remaining challenge is to extend this capability from largely planar molecules to non-planar molecular systems, where the most important structural information may be distributed across different heights above the surface. Here we use probe-particle-model simulations to predict the constant-force contours expected above molecules with increasing structural complexity. By extracting force isosurfaces from simulated three-dimensional force fields, we compare the molecular information retained in constant-height and constant-force images. For tilted benzene and pyrrole, constant-force images preserve the molecular framework across a range of adsorption angles and allow the molecular orientation to be recovered quantitatively. For larger non-planar and three-dimensional systems, simulations identify characteristic force-isosurface contrast associated with adsorption geometry, lower-lying molecular structure and curved molecular surfaces. These results provide target contrasts for force isosurfaces that could be extracted from three-dimensional force-mapping experiments, evaluating the molecular information retained by ideal force-isosurface imaging across progressively non-planar systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过探针-粒子模型模拟，研究如何利用原子力显微镜的恒力轮廓成像技术从非平面分子系统中提取关键结构信息，验证了恒力成像相比恒高成像在倾斜、非平面和三维分子体系中的优势。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率原子力显微镜已能直接揭示平面分子的分子内结构，但将其扩展到非平面分子系统仍是一大挑战，因为这些分子的关键结构信息分布在表面上方不同高度处。
AI.method: 使用探针-粒子模型模拟，计算具有递增结构复杂性的分子上方的恒力轮廓；从模拟的三维力场中提取力等值面，并比较恒高图像与恒力图像所保留的分子信息。
AI.result: 对于倾斜的苯和吡咯，恒力图像在不同吸附角度下都能保持分子框架，并能定量恢复分子取向；对于更大的非平面和三维系统，模拟识别出与吸附几何、较低层分子结构和弯曲分子表面相关的特征性力等值面对比度。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为可从三维力映射实验中提取的力等值面提供了目标对比度，评估了理想力等值面成像在逐渐复杂的非平面系统中保留的分子信息。

title: Ab Initio Investigation of Pressure Effects in the Spin-Liquid Candidate Y-Kapellasite
summary: Motivated by recent experiments showing pressure-induced suppression of magnetic order and the emergence of a dynamical ground state in the anisotropic kagome antiferromagnet Y-kapellasite Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8, we perform ab initio density functional theory (DFT)calculations to investigate the evolution of magnetic exchange interactions under hydrostatic pressure. We show that pressure efficiently tunes the magnetic Hamiltonian by altering the CuOCu bond geometry, thereby driving the system towards a spin-liquid regime. This evolution is governed by a nonlinear dependence of the dominant exchange coupling on the CuOCu bond angle. We further examine the influence of hydrogen positions and find that both the OH bond length and the hydrogen out-of-plane angle strongly affect the magnetic interactions. Our results provide a microscopic explanation for the experimentally observed pressure-induced enhancement of frustration and highlight the key role of hydrogen geometry.

AI.tldr: 通过DFT计算，研究了Y-kapellasite（Y₃Cu₉(OH)₁₉Cl₈）在静水压力下磁交换相互作用的演化，发现压力通过改变Cu-O-Cu键几何结构有效调控磁哈密顿量，推动系统进入自旋液体态，且氢键几何（OH键长和面外角）对磁相互作用有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 近期实验观察到Y-kapellasite在压力下磁有序被抑制并出现动力学基态，本文旨在从第一性原理角度揭示这一现象的微观机制。
AI.method: 采用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的ab initio计算，分析静水压力下磁交换耦合的变化，重点关注Cu-O-Cu键角、氢位置（OH键长和氢面外角）的影响。
AI.result: 压力有效调控磁哈密顿量，主导交换耦合对Cu-O-Cu键角呈非线性依赖；氢位置（OH键长和面外角）对磁相互作用影响显著。
AI.conclusion: 为实验观察到的压力诱导的挫败增强提供了微观解释，强调了氢几何结构在调控磁性中的关键作用。

title: Negative and Zero Linear Compressibility in MCN (M = Ag, Au, Cu): A First-Principles Study
summary: Negative linear compressibility (NLC) is the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a crystallographic axis expands under hydrostatic pressure. A related phenomenon, zero linear compressibility (ZLC), occurs when an axis shows no length change under pressure. Both responses are rare and arise in materials with highly anisotropic mechanical properties. Motivated by recent reports of anomalous behavior in metal cyanides - including negative thermal expansion and NLC - we use first-principles calculations to investigate the potential of the MCN family (M = Ag, Au, Cu) to exhibit ZLC or NLC. Our simulations reveal three main findings. First, we predict the existence of previously unreported phases: the P6mm phase for AgCN and CuCN, and the R3m phase for AuCN. Second, all six members of the MCN family studied exhibit extreme elastic anisotropy, which indeed leads to ZLC or NLC in each case. Third, we identify a mechanism for these responses distinct from previously reported ones. The mechanism arises from the unique "bamboo forest" geometry of the material: weakly interacting rigid rods whose sparse packing allows pressure to be accommodated through changes in packing density rather than rod compression. This mechanism enables the anomalous response to persist over a wide pressure range, contrasting favorably with other materials that exhibit similar behavior. Our findings expand the relatively small family of materials known to exhibit ZLC or NLC and provide deeper insight into the microscopic origin of these unusual mechanical responses.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理计算，预测MCN家族（M=Ag, Au, Cu）中存在未报道的P6mm和R3m相，并发现所有六种材料均表现出极端弹性各向异性，从而导致零线性压缩或负线性压缩行为，其机理源于独特的"竹林"几何结构：弱相互作用的刚性棒通过改变堆积密度而非棒本身压缩来容纳压力。
AI.motivation: 金属氰化物中已观察到负热膨胀和负线性压缩等反常行为，本文受此启发，旨在探索MCN家族（M=Ag, Au, Cu）是否具有零线性压缩或负线性压缩特性，并揭示其微观机制。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算对MCN家族（M=Ag, Au, Cu）进行模拟研究。
AI.result: （1）预测了新的未报道相：AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相、AuCN的R3m相；（2）所有六种MCN材料均表现出极端弹性各向异性，并因此呈现ZLC或NLC；（3）发现了一种与以往不同的新机制，源于"竹林"几何结构——弱相互作用的刚性棒通过堆积密度变化而非棒自身压缩来适应压力。该机制能在宽压力范围内维持反常响应。
AI.conclusion: 本研究拓展了已知具有ZLC或NLC特性的材料家族，并深入揭示了这些反常力学响应的微观起源。

title: Nonlinear Dynamics of Hopfion for Frequency Multiplication
summary: Hopfions, associated with higher-dimensional topology through the Hopf fibration, exhibit {exotic} features like {complex knot} and improved stability compared to skyrmions, enhancing their appeal for innovative applications. In this paper, we study the nonlinear response of magnetic Hopfion to microwave fields. {We observe the emergence of higher-order harmonics of the driving microwave field as it interacts with the Hopfion}. By carefully selecting the {driving frequency, the corresponding harmonic can efficiently excite localized magnon state of a Hopfion. Our results demonstrate the promising potential of hopfions in nonlinear magnonics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了磁性Hopfion在微波场中的非线性响应，发现高阶谐波的产生并证实其可有效激发局域磁子态，展示了Hopfion在非线性磁子学中的潜力。
AI.motivation: Hopfion具有比skyrmion更复杂的拓扑结构和更高的稳定性，有望用于新型磁子学器件，但其在微波场下的非线性响应尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 通过施加微波驱动场作用于磁性Hopfion，观察其非线性响应，特别是高阶谐波的产生，并调节驱动频率以匹配特定谐波来激发局域磁子态。
AI.result: 观察到微波场与Hopfion相互作用时产生高阶谐波；通过选择合适的驱动频率，谐波可高效激发Hopfion的局域磁子态。
AI.conclusion: Hopfion在非线性磁子学中具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Quantitative DFT+DMFT description of spectra and transport in the moderately correlated metal SrVO$_3$
summary: A quantitative, material-specific account of spectral and transport properties remains a central challenge in the theory of strongly correlated materials. Combining density functional theory with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) has proven to be a powerful approach for treating electron correlation effects and material specificity on an equal footing. Here, we examine the single-particle spectra and the dc and optical conductivity of SrVO$_3$, a prototypical, moderately correlated metal, within this framework. The degenerate $t_{2g}$ active space of SrVO$_3$, together with its well-established Fermi-liquid behavior, admits an effective-mass description governed by a single quasiparticle weight, yielding a nearly universal picture of the low-frequency, low-temperature regime. Employing a computationally efficient, real-frequency multi-orbital iterative perturbation theory (MO-IPT) impurity solver, we find reasonable agreement with experimental measurements of dc resistivity and optical conductivity across the entire experimentally relevant $(ω, T)$ range within a single, unified scheme. The agreement is shown to not depend on specific interaction parameters provided the quasiparticle weight is kept constant. These results indicate that, in SrVO$_3$, the $\mathbf{k}$-dependence of the self-energy may be weak, and vertex corrections may not dominate the dc and optical transport in this material.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT+DMFT框架，结合多轨道迭代微扰论( MO-IPT )杂质求解器，系统研究了典型中等关联金属SrVO₃的电子结构和输运性质。研究发现其低能物理可由单一准粒子权重描述，理论计算的电导率和光学性质与实验在广泛温频范围内吻合良好，且该结果对具体相互作用参数不敏感，暗示该材料中自能可能弱依赖于动量，顶点修正可能不占主导。
AI.motivation: 强关联材料中，同时处理材料特异性和电子关联效应是理论上的核心难题。虽然DFT+DMFT已证明是有效方案，但对实际材料如SrVO₃，需要验证其是否能在一个统一框架下定量描述全温频范围的输运和光谱性质。
AI.method: 采用DFT+DMFT框架，使用计算高效的实频多轨道迭代微扰论(MO-IPT)作为杂质求解器，计算SrVO₃的单粒子谱、直流电导率和光学电导率。
AI.result: 理论计算与实验测量的直流电阻率和光学电导率在全部相关(ω, T)范围内取得合理一致；该一致性不依赖具体的相互作用参数，只要保持准粒子权重不变即可。
AI.conclusion: SrVO₃中自能的k依赖可能较弱，顶点修正可能不主导其直流和光学输运过程，表明该材料可用简单的有效质量描述。

title: Are Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials Truly Practical? A Benchmark of 23 Mainstream Models
summary: Most MLIP benchmarks reward static accuracy while ignoring inference efficiency and hardware scalability -- driving model bloat with unclear real-world value. We benchmark 23 mainstream open-source MLIPs on a low-cost NVIDIA DGX Spark (128 GB native memory, capped at 80 GB to mimic ordinary lab hardware), using a fixed 192-atom system under a unified ASE-based pipeline. We evaluate three dimensions: predictive accuracy, MD simulation throughput, and atomic scalability. Our results expose a sharp accuracy-efficiency trade-off: large SOTA models deliver only 3-5 meV/atom more accuracy than lightweight ones, but lose orders of magnitude in throughput -- in the worst case, becoming only marginally faster than DFT itself. Lightweight MLIPs, by contrast, sit on the Pareto frontier and run on modest hardware. The lesson is that single-dimensional benchmarks mislead the field, and that future MLIP development should value efficiency and scalability alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文在低成本硬件上系统对比了23个主流开源MLIP模型，发现大型SOTA模型相比轻量模型精度提升仅3-5 meV/atom，但吞吐量下降数个数量级，甚至接近DFT速度；轻量模型在帕累托前沿上表现更优，揭示了单维度基准测试的误导性，呼吁未来MLIP开发应兼顾效率与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 现有MLIP基准测试只关注静态精度，忽视推理效率和硬件可扩展性，导致模型臃肿膨胀，实际应用价值存疑。
AI.method: 在低成本NVIDIA DGX Spark（限制80GB内存模拟普通实验室硬件）上，使用统一ASE框架，对23个开源MLIP在固定192原子体系下进行三维度评估：预测精度、MD模拟吞吐量、原子可扩展性。
AI.result: 大型SOTA模型精度仅比轻量模型高3-5 meV/atom，但吞吐量损失数个数量级，最差情况下仅比DFT稍快；轻量MLIP处于帕累托前沿，可在普通硬件上高效运行。
AI.conclusion: 单维度基准测试具有误导性，未来MLIP开发应同时重视效率、可扩展性与精度。

title: AI2Pot: A scalable and unified framework for machine-learning interatomic potential development and large-scale molecular dynamic simulations
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) bridge the accuracy of first-principles calculations and the efficiency required for large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. However, existing MLIP software remains fragmented across different model architectures, making it difficult to establish unified workflows that support flexible model development, efficient training, and scalable MD deployment. Here, we present AI2Pot, a scalable and unified MLIP framework that seamlessly integrates model training, evaluation, and large-scale MD simulations with PyTorch-compatible ecosystem. Instead of relying on generic automatic differentiation for expensive atomistic operators, AI2Pot re-engineers the core computations of Moment tensor potential (MTP) and Neuroevolution potential (NEP) for both training and inference using hand-crafted C++/CUDA code. These specialized operators constitute a unified computational backend shared by training and inference, improving training-inference consistency and reducing memory usage by avoiding large intermediate caches. As a result, AI2Pot enables fast inference for large-scale atomic systems containing millions of atoms on a single GPU, while retaining the flexibility of PyTorch for model construction, training, and evaluation. Trained models can be deployed in ASE and LAMMPS for MD simulations. Furthermore, AI2Pot provides a companion command-line toolkit (AI2Pot-cli) and Python APIs to facilitate practical MLIP workflows. By unifying high-performance atomistic computing with modern machine-learning ecosystems, AI2Pot offers an user-friendly end-to-end framework for the developing, training, and deploying MLIPs for large scale MD.

AI.tldr: AI2Pot是一个统一的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）框架，通过PyTorch兼容的接口和手写C++/CUDA算子，将模型训练、评估和百万原子级分子动力学模拟集成到同一平台，解决了现有MLIP软件分散、工作流不统一的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有MLIP软件因模型架构不同而碎片化严重，难以建立统一的开发、训练和部署工作流，亟需一个端到端的高性能框架。
AI.method: 重新设计MTP和NEP的核心计算为手写C++/CUDA算子，作为训练和推理的统一计算后端，避免自动微分带来的大中间缓存开销，同时保持PyTorch的灵活性。
AI.result: 单GPU上可推理百万原子级系统，减少内存使用，提升训练-推理一致性，并支持在ASE和LAMMPS中部署MD模拟。
AI.conclusion: AI2Pot通过统一高性能原子计算与现代机器学习生态系统，提供了一个友好的端到端框架，用于大规模MD中MLIP的开发、训练和部署。

title: Tunnel-rate controlled local heat distribution in mesoscopic circuits
summary: Solid-state quantum technologies, including qubits and quantum metrology circuits, demand milli-Kelvin operation to preserve fragile quantum states from classical noise. While the negligible electron-phonon coupling is the major impediment, reaching 50 mK electron temperature is further suffered by the high electrical resistance and sub-micron-scale dimensions of typical devices, limiting conventional heat dissipation. Though the phonons are effectively frozen, thermoelectric techniques could offer a viable path for heat management.This work explores thermally driven electrical transport in a gated quantum dot (QD) on a GaAs-AlGaAs two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), to control heat flow between the source and drain reservoirs.By exploiting the QD's discrete energy spectrum and tuneable tunnel rates, a precise control over the polarity and magnitude of the resulting thermoelectric current is demonstrated. A temperature difference of 650 mK is maintained across the QD, a separation of 400 nm, by tuning the tunnel-rates. An experimental gate pulsing method is also introduced to directly measure the electron temperature differences across the QD, bypassing the need for any theoretical fits. The results presented here show that tuneable tunnel barriers can be used for local heat control, and could lead to advanced quantum refrigerators that work efficiently in mesoscopic circuits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用GaAs-AlGaAs二维电子气中的门控量子点，通过可调隧穿势垒控制热流，在400纳米间距上维持650 mK温差，并引入门脉冲方法直接测量电子温差，为介观电路中的量子制冷提供新途径。
AI.motivation: 固态量子技术（量子比特、量子计量电路）需要在mK级温度下运行以保护量子态，但传统散热方式因高电阻和亚微米尺寸受限；尽管声子被冻结，热电技术可能提供热管理方案。
AI.method: 利用GaAs-AlGaAs 2DEG上的门控量子点，通过调控量子点的离散能谱和隧穿速率，控制源漏之间的热电流极性及大小；并引入门脉冲方法直接测量电子温差。
AI.result: 成功在400 nm间距的量子点两端维持650 mK的温差，实现了热电电流极性和大小的精确控制，并通过门脉冲方法直接测量了电子温差。
AI.conclusion: 可调隧穿势垒可用于局部热控制，有望实现高效工作的介观电路量子制冷器件。

title: Crossover and Changeover in Spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ Chain with Uniaxial Single-ion Anisotropy
summary: Recent advances in bond-directional spin chains have revealed extensive emergent phenomena and unconventional criticality. Here we investigate the spin-1 Kitaev-$Γ$ chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy (SIA) using large-scale density-matrix renormalization group calculations and bosonization analysis. Tuning the SIA strength reveals a crossover from the Kitaev phase to the large-$D$ phase, evidenced by the excitation gap changing from quadratic to linear, the coexistence and smooth evolution of spin-nematic and string order parameters, and the suppression of the double-peak specific heat. For negative SIA, we uncover a changeover from a first-order transition to a continuous one between the dimerized and Haldane phases. The continuous transition belongs to the \textrm{SU(2)$_2$} Wess-Zumino-Witten universality class with central charge $c=3/2$, a rare instance in a system without continuous symmetry. Our results establish the Kitaev-$Γ$ chain as a minimal platform for controlling crossover and changeover phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DMRG和玻色化分析研究了自旋1的Kitaev-Γ链中的单轴单离子各向异性效应，发现了从Kitaev相到大D相的交叉行为、负SIA下从一级相变到SU(2)₂ WZW普适类连续相变的转变。
AI.motivation: 探索键方向自旋链中新兴现象和非常规临界性，具体研究单离子各向异性对自旋1 Kitaev-Γ链相图的影响。
AI.method: 大规模密度矩阵重正化群(DMRG)计算和玻色化(bosonization)分析。
AI.result: SIA强度调控导致Kitaev相到大D相交叉（激发隙从二次到线性变化、自旋向列和弦序共存演化、双峰比热被抑制）；负SIA下 dimerized相与Haldane相之间从一级相变转为连续相变，属于中心电荷c=3/2的SU(2)₂ WZW普适类。
AI.conclusion: Kitaev-Γ链可作为控制交叉(crossover)和转变(changeover)现象的最小平台，尤其发现了在无连续对称性系统中罕见的SU(2)₂ WZW临界行为。

title: Surface-Reconstruction-Driven Insulating Behavior in Metallic Charge-Density-Wave 1T-TaSe$_{2}$
summary: Bulk 1T-TaSe$_2$ is metallic, yet its surface consistently exhibits an insulating gap -- a dichotomy long attributed to a surface Mott insulator driven by enhanced electron correlations. Here, using density functional theory calculations, we show that this insulating surface instead originates from a charge-density-wave (CDW) stacking reconstruction. Whereas the bulk stabilizes a single-layer CDW stacking that supports metallic transport, the surface energetically favors a bilayer stacking, in which interlayer hybridization of Ta $5d_{z^2}$ orbitals opens a $\sim$0.4 eV gap -- a band insulator requiring no on-site Coulomb repulsion. This reconstruction is the thermodynamic ground state for slab thicknesses from two to eight layers, and the calculated surface density of states quantitatively reproduces scanning tunneling spectra for both insulating and metallic domains. Our results establish CDW surface reconstruction, rather than Mott physics, as the mechanism governing the surface electronic structure of 1T-TaSe$_2$ and provide a unified explanation for the experimentally observed coexistence of metallic and insulating domains.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT计算表明，1T-TaSe2表面的绝缘间隙源于电荷密度波堆叠重构（表面偏好双层堆叠打开~0.4 eV能隙），而非此前认为的Mott绝缘体机制，并统一解释了实验观测到的金属与绝缘域共存现象。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，1T-TaSe2体相金属性但表面绝缘的二分现象被归因于表面Mott绝缘体（增强电子关联所致）。作者希望验证这一长期假设是否成立，并揭示真正的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析不同堆叠方式下的电子结构；对比单层与双层CDW堆叠的稳定性；计算表面态密度并与实验STM谱进行定量比较。
AI.result: 体相稳定的单层CDW堆叠支持金属输运，而表面热力学偏好双层CDW堆叠；双层堆叠中Ta 5d_{z^2}轨道的层间杂化打开了约0.4 eV的能隙（能带绝缘体，无需库仑排斥）；2-8层薄片下该重构均为热力学基态；计算的表面态密度定量复现了STM实验谱中绝缘域和金属域的特征。
AI.conclusion: 1T-TaSe2表面绝缘间隙的起源是CDW表面重构（双层堆叠导致的能带绝缘），而非Mott物理；该机制统一解释了实验中金属域与绝缘域共存的现象。

title: Unveiling the Spin-Valley Structure of Dipolar Exciton Ladders in R-stacked WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ Moiré Heterobilayers
comment: Main text: 9 pages, 4 figures; Supplemental Material included
summary: Localized interlayer excitons in moiré heterobilayers can form dipolar exciton ladders, yet their internal spin-valley structure remains unresolved. Here, we use helicity-resolved magneto-photoluminescence to identify the microscopic origin of the ladder in R-stacked WSe$_2$/WS$_2$ at charge neutrality and one-electron filling of the moiré lattice. At charge neutrality, the first two emission peaks correspond to a spin-triplet interlayer exciton and a triplet-triplet two-exciton state separated by 38 meV, reflecting the on-site dipolar interaction. The opposite Zeeman response of the apparent third rung of the ladder rules out its assignment as a spin-conserving three-exciton state and instead identifies it as a triplet-singlet two-exciton configuration with a 22 meV offset set by the WS$_2$ conduction-band spin splitting. At one-electron filling, the correlated electronic background gives rise to charged one- and two-exciton states and intervalley/intravalley two-exciton configurations, while reducing the effective exciton-exciton interaction. Our results establish a spin-valley-resolved picture of dipolar exciton ladders beyond simple occupation-number physics in moiré heterobilayers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过螺旋分辨磁光致发光光谱，揭示了R型堆叠WSe₂/WS₂莫尔异质层中偶极激子梯子的自旋-能谷微观结构，重新标定了各梯级对应的多激子态构型。
AI.motivation: 莫尔异质层中的局域层间激子可形成偶极激子梯子，但其内部的自旋-能谷结构尚未被解析。
AI.method: 采用螺旋分辨磁光致发光（helicity-resolved magneto-photoluminescence）技术，研究R型堆叠WSe₂/WS₂在电荷中性和单电子填充莫尔晶格条件下的光谱特征。
AI.result: 电荷中性时，前两个发射峰分别对应自旋三重态层间激子和三重态-三重态双激子态（能量差38 meV，源于局域偶极相互作用）；第三个"梯级"并非自旋守恒的三激子态，而是三重态-单态双激子构型（能量偏移22 meV，由WS₂导带自旋劈裂决定）。单电子填充时，相关电子背景产生带电单/双激子态及谷间/谷内双激子构型，同时有效激子-激子相互作用减弱。
AI.conclusion: 建立了莫尔异质层中偶极激子梯子的自旋-能谷分辨图像，揭示了其超越简单占据数物理的复杂微观机制。

title: Strain-tunable charge localization coupled to complex magnetic orders in EuAl$_4$
summary: Charge localization is particularly interesting when coupled to antiferromagnetic spin structures. Coupled spin-charge orders are well established in elemental chromium and correlated oxide superconductors, yet the interplay between charge order and more complex magnetic textures -- such as skyrmion lattices and chiral spin structures -- remains largely unexplored. Here we report a comprehensive study of how charge localization couples to the unusually rich sequence of magnetic phases in EuAl$_4$. Using x-ray diffraction under applied magnetic field and uniaxial pressure, we demonstrate a direct coupling between the charge and spin order parameters. In the absence of external stimuli, charge localization is markedly enhanced upon entering the magnetically ordered phases. Strikingly, this effect is highly susceptible to strain: uniaxial pressure applied along the charge-order propagation direction further enhances localization, whereas pressure applied perpendicular to it weakens it. Application of magnetic field reveals both competitive and possible collaborative interactions between spin and charge ordering.This flexible coupling between spin and charge ordering opens a new route to designing symmetry-breaking states. Chiral charge order may for example be patterned from spin structures with that symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了EuAl₄中电荷局域化与复杂磁性相（包括螺旋磁结构和斯格明子晶格）之间的耦合关系。通过X射线衍射、外加磁场和单轴压力实验，发现电荷序与磁序之间存在直接耦合：进入磁有序相后电荷局域化显著增强，且这一效应对应变高度敏感。这种灵活的自旋-电荷耦合为设计对称性破缺态提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 自旋-电荷耦合在铬元素和氧化物超导体中已有研究，但电荷序与更复杂磁结构（如斯格明子晶格、手性自旋结构）之间的相互作用尚未被探索。本文旨在填补这一空白，研究EuAl₄中电荷局域化如何与其丰富的磁性相序列耦合。
AI.method: 采用X射线衍射技术，结合外加磁场和单轴压力调控，系统研究EuAl₄中电荷局域化与磁性相的耦合关系。通过对比无外部刺激时、施加单轴压力（沿不同方向）以及外加磁场下的电荷序变化，揭示自旋-电荷耦合机制。
AI.result: 进入磁有序相后电荷局域化显著增强；沿电荷序传播方向施加单轴压力进一步增强局域化，垂直方向则削弱；外加磁场下自旋与电荷序存在竞争性和可能的协同性相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 自旋与电荷序之间存在灵活可调的耦合作用，这种耦合为设计对称性破缺态提供了新思路，例如可以从具有手性对称性的自旋结构中图案化出对应的手性电荷序。

title: Size focusing in core-shell precipitates: A phase-field study
summary: Due to their enhanced resistance to coarsening and/or creep, aluminium alloys with precipitates of two distinct phases in a core-shell morphology are of great contemporary interest. In this paper, we focus on the curious observation in two recent studies on Al-Sc-Li and Al-Yb-Li alloys that growth of the shell phase leads to a narrowing of the size distribution. We have studied this phenomenon, known as size focusing, using a theoretical framework (which extends Zener's theory of diffusional growth to a core-shell precipitate) and multi-precipitate simulations based on a phase field model. Our results yield key theoretical insights as well as conclusions with practical significance. (a) On the theoretical front, we show clearly that size focusing is a growth phenomenon: it ends when shell growth ends, and coarsening begins. (b) On the practical front, our results offer guidelines for designing alloys with narrower size distributions: size focusing is promoted in alloys with greater shell volume fractions and greater inter-precipitate spacing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Al-Sc-Li和Al-Yb-Li合金中核-壳结构析出相的生长导致尺寸分布变窄（尺寸聚焦）的现象，通过理论框架和相场模拟证明尺寸聚焦是生长现象，并提出了获得更窄尺寸分布的合金设计指南。
AI.motivation: 核-壳形貌析出相因其抗粗化和抗蠕变性能而备受关注，但近期实验发现壳相生长会导致析出相尺寸分布变窄（尺寸聚焦），这一现象的机理尚不明确。
AI.method: 扩展Zener扩散生长理论至核-壳析出相，结合多析出相相场模型模拟，从理论和模拟两个层面分析尺寸聚焦现象。
AI.result: (a) 尺寸聚焦是生长现象，壳相生长结束时尺寸聚焦结束，粗化开始；(b) 更大的壳相体积分数和更大的析出相间距有利于促进尺寸聚焦。
AI.conclusion: 明确了尺寸聚焦的本质是生长而非粗化现象，并为设计具有更窄尺寸分布的合金提供了实用指导原则。

title: Geometric Interpretation of Sum Photon Blockade
summary:
We present a geometric interpretation of the sum photon blockade effect in multimode quantum optical systems, such as semiconductor microresonators. The blockade condition \(c^{(n)} \cdot v = 0\) reflects the orthogonality of the \(n\)-photon amplitude vector to a target mode vector in an \(N\)-dimensional Hilbert space, visualized as the confinement of the state to a hyperplane.
  A key result is the calculation of the maximum probability of the system remaining in the blockade subspace under the influence of decoherence processes (in particular, dephasing), which determines the practical feasibility and robustness of the effect. This approach extends to higher-order correlators \(g^{(2)}_Σ\) and cross-correlations, enabling the design of scalable quantum devices.
  We introduce the concept of "dark-state typicality": as the number of modes \(M\) increases, the dark subspace annihilated by the collective mode operator asymptotically occupies a unit fraction of the \(n\)-boson Hilbert space. This allows the transition from fragile, finely tuned mechanisms to macroscopically robust non-classical light in large multimode bosonic architectures.
  We consider continuum collective modes, hypotheses on correlation zeros and invariant manifolds, as well as the relationship between blockade and entanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文对多模量子光学系统中的和光子阻塞效应提出了几何解释，揭示了暗态典型性现象：随着模式数增加，暗子空间渐近占据n-玻色子希尔伯特空间的单位分数，使非经典光从脆弱机制转向宏观鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 为多模系统中的和光子阻塞效应提供几何直观理解，解决高维希尔伯特空间中该效应的可视化问题，并评估退相干影响下的实际可行性。
AI.method: 通过将n光子振幅向量与目标模式向量的正交性（c^(n)·v=0）解释为超平面约束，引入"暗态典型性"概念，分析退相干下的最大阻塞概率，扩展到高阶关联函数。
AI.result: 证明了暗态典型性：随模式数M增加，暗子空间渐近占据n-玻色子希尔伯特空间的单位分数，为大规模多模玻色子系统中的鲁棒非经典光提供了理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可扩展量子器件设计提供了新范式，从精细调谐机制转向宏观鲁棒的非经典光源，并建立了阻塞与纠缠之间的深层联系。

title: Raman spectroscopic signature of Kitaev magnetism and complex spin-lattice coupling in S = 1/2 antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO$_6$ double perovskite
summary: We report a detailed analysis of temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and Co $K$-edge extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) for a pseudospin-$\tilde{S}=1/2$ insulating antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO$_6$, a B-site--ordered double perovskite hosting Co$^{2+}$ ($3d^7$) ions on an {\it f.c.c.} sublattice. Notably, pronounced anomalies in the phonon frequency, linewidth and spectral weight are observed around 60~K, well above the long-range antiferromagnetic transition at $T_{\rm N} \approx 15$~K. These renormalizations indicate a significant coupling between lattice and spin degrees of freedom, although a purely structural contribution cannot be excluded. Additional modifications of both high- and low-energy Raman modes are detected near 160-180 K, including changes in linewidth and intensity, variations of the Fano asymmetry parameter, and the emergence of an additional low-energy feature. The asymmetric Fano line shape of selected low-energy modes, together with a broad low-energy continuum and quasielastic response, suggests coupling between discrete phonons and fluctuating magnetic excitations. Moreover, the EXAFS analysis reveals correlated changes in bond distances and Debye-Waller factors around the Co ions near 60~K and 160~K, evidencing subtle local structural distortions and possible magnetostrictive effects. The persistence of anomalous lattice dynamics far above $T_{\rm N}$, combined with the excitation-energy--independent continuum, is consistent with fluctuating bond-directional interactions and proximate Kitaev-like correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过温度依赖的拉曼光谱和EXAFS分析，研究了SrLaCoNbO₆双钙钛矿中Co²⁺离子的晶格-自旋耦合，发现远高于反磁相变温度（15 K）的60 K和160-180 K处存在显著的声子异常和局域结构畸变，暗示了键方向性相互作用和类Kitaev关联。
AI.motivation: 探究SrLaCoNbO₆中Co²⁺（3d⁷）离子在f.c.c.子晶格上的晶格-自旋耦合效应，特别是远高于长程反铁磁有序温度（T_N≈15 K）时出现的反常晶格动力学行为。
AI.method: 采用温度依赖的拉曼光谱和Co K-edge扩展X射线吸收精细结构（EXAFS）分析，系统测量声子频率、线宽、谱权重及Fano不对称参数，并结合EXAFS提取键长和Debye-Waller因子的温度演化。
AI.result: 在60 K附近观察到声子频率、线宽和谱权重的明显异常（高于T_N）；在160-180 K区域检测到高能和低能拉曼模式的变化、Fano不对称参数变化以及额外低能特征的出现；EXAFS显示Co离子周围键长和Debye-Waller因子在60 K和160 K附近存在关联变化，表明局域结构畸变和可能的磁致伸缩效应。
AI.conclusion: 拉曼和EXAFS的异常表明存在显著的晶格-自旋耦合，远高于T_N时持续存在的异常晶格动力学与激发能量无关的连续谱一致，支持键方向性相互作用波动和近似的Kitaev类关联。

title: Minimizing propagated density errors of atomic core-electron for simultaneously accurate bandgaps and lattice constants in closed-shell Copper semiconductors
summary: Density functional theory struggles to accurately determine electron density of atoms, whose error is inevitably encoded into the pseudopotential and propagated into solid-state calculations. However, little is known about how this affects accuracy nor how to remedy it. In this work, through a systematic study of the effect of Cu atomic density on bandgap and lattice constants of over 50 Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors, we find that core-electron density can drastically affect nuclear attraction to valence electrons and subsequent charge distribution and energy position of Cu 3$d$ electrons. The error can be eliminated at its source by employing modified Hartree-Fock pseudopotentials for Cu core while retaining (semi-)local functionals for valence electrons. This real-space partitioning approach leads to simultaneous high-accuracy in bandgap and lattice constants across the entire material class.

AI.tldr: DFT计算中Cu原子核电子密度误差会通过赝势传播到固体计算中。通过研究50多种含Cu半导体，发现核电子密度显著影响价电子和能带结构。采用修正的Hartree-Fock赝势处理Cu核，同时保留(semi-)local泛函处理价电子，可以同时高精度预测带隙和晶格常数。
AI.motivation: DFT对原子电子密度的计算存在固有误差，这一误差会通过赝势编码并传播到固体计算中，但尚不清楚其对精度的影响程度及如何修正。
AI.method: 系统研究50多种含Cu闭壳层半导体中Cu原子密度对带隙和晶格常数的影响；采用修正的Hartree-Fock赝势处理Cu核电子，保留(semi-)local泛函处理价电子，实现实空间分区处理。
AI.result: 核电子密度显著影响价电子的核吸引、电荷分布以及Cu 3d电子的能级位置；所提出的分区方法可在整个材料类别中同时实现带隙和晶格常数的高精度预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过修正Cu核的赝势，可以从源头消除DFT的电子密度误差，实现含Cu半导体材料带隙和晶格常数的高精度同时预测。

title: Non-Hermitian Edge State Endocytosis
summary: An isolated edge state observed in a finite open chain is usually expected to survive the thermodynamic limit (TDL), with a localization mechanism distinct from non-Hermitian skin accumulation, which localizes the \emph{entire} bulk continuum. We show that scale-sensitive non-Hermitian systems can generically admit a different fate: as we scale up the system size, a detached edge-localized eigenstate can remain sharply visible over a broad window until a critical scale is reached, where it forms an ephemeral bound state in the continuum (BIC) of the open-boundary bulk before being absorbed (entocytosed) at even larger system sizes. We call this phenomenon edge state endocytosis. Its mechanism is fundamentally traced to the Widom expansion of the open-chain characteristic determinant (energy dispersion equation) into contributions corresponding to admissible non-Bloch mode subsets. Each subset contribution factorizes into a boundary-projected Green's function (proj-GF) determinant, which encodes lattice truncation, and a subset-resolved bulk propagation factor, which encodes the system size dependence. We uncover the fundamental distinction: TDL edge states are zeros of the leading-subset proj-GF determinant, whereas endocytosed states are a hitherto-ignored class of hidden proj-GF zeros from subleading subsets that control the spectrum at finite sizes. Due to its fundamental mathematical origin, the endocytosis mechanism is completely platform-independent, occurring generically without fine-tuning when isolated edge states, topological or otherwise, are subject to non-Hermitian couplings that generate the requisite non-locality. Our new framework quantitatively predicts the endocytosis scale and sheds light on how its intricate competitive mechanism can be revealed through experimentally relevant Green's functions.

AI.tldr: 本文发现非厄米系统中一种新现象——边缘态内吞（edge state endocytosis）：随系统尺寸增大，原本孤立的边缘态会在临界尺寸时成为连续谱中的瞬态束缚态（BIC），随后被更大尺寸下的体态吸收而消失。该现象源于开放链特征行列式的Widom展开中，次主导子集对应的隐藏边界投影格林函数零点，与热力学极限下主导子集的零点机制本质不同。
AI.motivation: 传统认为有限开链中的孤立边缘态会在热力学极限下存活，其局域化机制不同于非厄米趋肤效应（后者局域化整个体态连续谱）。本文发现存在另一种可能性：边缘态在特定尺寸下消失，需要揭示其物理机制和数学根源。
AI.method: 通过开放链特征行列式（能量色散方程）的Widom展开，将行列式分解为不同非Bloch模式子集的贡献。每个子集贡献因子化为边界投影格林函数行列式（编码晶格截断效应）和子集分辨的体传播因子（编码系统尺寸依赖）。通过分析不同子集的投影格林函数零点，区分热力学极限边缘态（主导子集零点）和内吞态（次主导子集零点）。
AI.result: 揭示了边缘态内吞现象：随尺寸增大，孤立边缘态在达到临界尺寸前保持清晰可见，在临界点形成连续谱中的瞬态束缚态（BIC），之后被体态吸收（内吞）。该机制具有平台无关性，无需精细调谐，只要非厄米耦合产生非局域性即可发生。框架可定量预测内吞临界尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 边缘态内吞是一种普适的、平台无关的机制，源于非厄米系统中次主导子集的隐藏投影格林函数零点。该发现修正了传统认为边缘态必然在热力学极限下存活的认知，提供了通过实验可测的格林函数揭示这一竞争机制的途径。

title: Wavelength-resolved small-angle neutron spectroscopy of spin waves in MnSi under pressure
summary: We report wavelength-resolved spin-wave small-angle neutron scattering (SWSANS) on the time-of-flight SANS instrument BL01 at the China Spallation Neutron Source and extend the method to pressure-cell measurements of MnSi. MnSi is used as a benchmark B20 helimagnet because its helimagnetic order and spin-wave stiffness are well characterized at ambient pressure. In a fixed magnetic field, the time-of-flight measurement provides a spectrum of neutron wavelengths. For each detector branch $s=\pm1$, the intensity profile is recentered relative to the wavelength-dependent Bragg angle $θ_B (λ) = k_s λ/ 2π$, and the cutoff angle $θ_C (λ)$ is extracted in the local branch coordinate. The cutoff-derived spin-wave stiffness $A$ is obtained from a linear fit of $θ_C^2$ as a function of $λ^2$. Ambient-pressure measurements reproduce the known stiffness scale of MnSi. Structural SANS at ambient pressure and at nominal 5 and 11 kbar verifies the magnetic state and provides an internal pressure-state check for the pressure-cell measurements. At nominal 11 kbar, within the present cutoff model, the cutoff-derived stiffness is substantially reduced, whereas the structural field scale $H_{C2}$ remains high. This contrast shows that $A$ cannot be inferred from static structural parameters alone under pressure. To our knowledge, these measurements constitute the first SWSANS implementation on a pulsed neutron source and the first SWSANS determination of spin-wave stiffness under pressure. The experiment also shows that reliable high-pressure SWSANS on a pulsed source requires high source brilliance, stable wavelength-dependent normalization, and sufficient statistics in each wavelength window.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在脉冲中子源上实现了波长分辨的自旋波小角中子散射（SWSANS），并将其扩展到MnSi的高压测量。通过飞行时间方法测量了MnSi在不同压力下的自旋波刚度，发现11 kbar下自旋波刚度显著降低，而静态结构场标度仍保持较高水平，表明不能仅从静态结构参数推断自旋波刚度。
AI.motivation: 传统SANS仅能测量静态磁结构，无法直接获取自旋波动力学信息。本研究旨在开发一种能在脉冲中子源上进行波长分辨SWSANS的方法，并将其扩展到高压环境，以探究压力对自旋波刚度的影响。
AI.method: 在中国散裂中子源BL01飞行时间SANS谱仪上，利用波长分辨的自旋波小角中子散射方法，对MnSi在常压和高压（5、11 kbar）下进行测量。通过飞行时间测量获取中子波长谱，在每个探测器分支中对强度分布进行相对于波长依赖的Bragg角的重心校正，提取截止角θ_C(λ)，并通过θ_C^2与λ^2的线性拟合得到自旋波刚度A。
AI.result: 常压测量复现了MnSi已知的自旋波刚度标度。名义11 kbar下，在现有截止模型内，截止推导的自旋波刚度显著降低，而结构场标度H_C2仍保持较高水平。这表明自旋波刚度不能从静态结构参数直接推断。这也是首次在脉冲中子源上实现SWSANS，以及首次在高压下测定自旋波刚度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功将SWSANS扩展到高压环境，证实了高压下自旋波刚度与静态磁结构参数解耦。实验同时指出，在脉冲源上进行可靠的高压SWSANS需要高源亮度、稳定的波长依赖归一化以及每个波长窗口内足够的统计量。

title: A modified Moss rule highlights underexplored classes of high refractive index materials
summary: High refractive index dielectrics are central to photonic applications, yet the empirical Moss rule imposes a fundamental trade-off between refractive index and optical transparency. We introduce a modified Moss rule anchored to the optical absorption edge rather than the fundamental bandgap, capturing materials where various physical mechanisms suppress absorption well above the electronic gap. Screening the Materials Project database with this metric reveals recurring chemical compositions and structural prototypes in the materials with the most promising refractive index/transparency trade-offs. These materials include chalcopyrites, Zintl pnictides, and early transition metal multi-anion chalconitrides and oxychalcogenides compounds. Hybrid density functional theory calculations reveal that the chalconitride (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 family can achieve a combination of ultra-high refractive indices, low effective masses and transparency windows extending deep into the UV, surpassing state-of-the-art TiO2 and SiC. Our results establish (Hf,Zr)2(S,Se)N2 compounds as a unique and largely unexplored material family for next-generation photonic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过改进Moss规则，从Materials Project数据库中筛选出具有优异折射率/透明度权衡的材料，发现(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂系列化合物可实现超高折射率、低有效质量及深紫外透明窗口，优于现有TiO₂和SiC，为下一代光子应用提供了新材料家族。
AI.motivation: 高折射率电介质在光子应用中至关重要，但经验性Moss规则指出折射率与光学透明度之间存在根本性权衡。作者希望突破这一限制，寻找能同时实现高折射率和高透明度的新材料。
AI.method: 提出修正的Moss规则，以光学吸收边而非基本带隙为基准；利用此指标筛选Materials Project数据库；通过混合密度泛函理论（Hybrid DFT）计算验证候选材料的性能。
AI.result: 发现黄铜矿、Zintl磷化物、早期过渡金属多阴离子硫氮化物和氧硫属化物等材料家族具有优异的折射率/透明度权衡。其中(Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂系列可实现超高折射率、低有效质量和深紫外透明窗口，性能超越TiO₂和SiC。
AI.conclusion: (Hf,Zr)₂(S,Se)N₂化合物是一个独特且尚未充分开发的材料家族，适合用于下一代光子应用。

title: Multistage development of short-range spin correlations and weak magnetic order in the two coupled trillium lattices of K2Fe2(MoO4)(PO4)2
summary: Trillium lattices, where magnetic ions form a chiral network of corner-sharing triangles, offer a three-dimensional magnetic framework that can host fragile classical spin-liquid states. Herein, we report on the magnetization, specific heat, electron spin resonance (ESR), and muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR) of K$_{2}$Fe$_{2}$(MoO$_{4}$)(PO$_{4}$)$_{2}$ single crystals. Magnetization measurements reveal strong antiferromagnetic interactions coexisting with weak magnetic order at $T_{\rm N} = 5.2$~K, as evidenced by a $λ$-like anomaly observed in the magnetic susceptibility, a critical enhancement of the muon spin relaxation rate and the wipeout of the ESR signal as the temperature approaches $T_{\rm N}$. Above $T_{\rm N}$, two distinct developments of short-range spin correlations are identified at $T_{\rm H} = 34$~K and $T_{\rm L} = 10$~K, supported by magnetic specific heat anomalies and the temperature dependence of the ESR linewidth and $g$-factor. Upon cooling below $T_{\rm N}$, an anomaly appears at $T^{*} = 3.2$~K in thermodynamic observables and the muon spin relaxation rate, indicative of spin reorientation driven by residual interactions. Despite the presence of magnetic order, $μ$SR experiments reveal dynamically fluctuating spins persisting even in the ordered state. Moreover, the suppression of $T_{\rm N}$ under applied magnetic fields ($μ_{0}H \geq 2$~T) suggests that K$_{2}$Fe$_{2}$(MoO$_{4}$)(PO$_{4}$)$_{2}$ constitutes a promising candidate for exploring field-induced spin-liquid behavior in three-dimensionally coupled trillium lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂单晶的磁性研究，发现其在三维三叶草晶格中表现出强反铁磁相互作用与弱磁有序共存，并在高温区存在两段短程自旋关联演化，低温下存在残余相互作用导致的自旋重取向，且有序态中仍存在动态自旋涨落；外加磁场可抑制磁有序，提示该体系是探索三维三叶草晶格中场致自旋液体行为的候选材料。
AI.motivation: 三叶草晶格作为一种三维手性磁性离子网络，理论上可以承载脆弱的经典自旋液体态，但实验验证尚不充分。作者希望通过研究K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂这一具体材料体系，揭示其三叶草晶格中磁相互作用的特性以及是否存在自旋液体行为。
AI.method: 采用磁化强度、比热、电子自旋共振和μ子自旋弛豫等多种实验手段，对K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂单晶进行系统测量，分析其热力学和自旋动力学性质。
AI.result: 1) 在TN=5.2K出现弱磁有序，同时存在强反铁磁相互作用；2) 在TN以上分别于TH=34K和TL=10K出现两段短程自旋关联；3) 在T*=3.2K观察到自旋重取向异常；4) 有序态中仍存在动态自旋涨落；5) 外加磁场≥2T可抑制TN。
AI.conclusion: K₂Fe₂(MoO₄)(PO₄)₂是探索三维三叶草晶格中场致自旋液体行为的有前途的候选材料。

title: Phonon scattering mechanisms in WTe$_2$ observed by ultrafast coherent phonon spectroscopy
summary: Revealing the mechanisms of phonon scattering is crucial for understanding material properties such as transport characteristics and optical responses. It can be discussed by measuring the temperature dependence of the phonon energy and lifetime. To gain insight into these mechanisms in Weyl semimetal T$_d$-WTe$_2$, we investigated coherent phonons using time-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy in a wide temperature range from 4.6 to 300 K. The temperature dependence of the frequency and decay rate of the two high-frequency optical modes was described by the conventional anharmonic phonon-phonon scattering model. In contrast, the low-frequency mode at 2.4 THz exhibited anomalous behavior, which can be interpreted as the contribution of phonon-electron scattering.

AI.tldr: 本文通过时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱，在4.6-300K范围内研究了Weyl半金属T$_d$-WTe$_2$的相干声子，发现高频光学声子符合常规非谐声子-声子散射模型，而低频2.4 THz模式表现异常，归因于声子-电子散射的贡献。
AI.motivation: 揭示Weyl半金属T$_d$-WTe$_2$中声子散射的机制，尤其是不同频率声子模式对温度的依赖行为，以深入理解其输运特性和光学响应。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨泵浦-探测光谱（泵浦-探测光谱）技术，在4.6K至300K的宽温区内测量相干声子，分析声子频率和衰减速率随温度的变化。
AI.result: 高频光学声子的温度依赖行为符合传统的非谐声子-声子散射模型；低频2.4 THz模式表现出异常的温度依赖，无法用该模型解释。
AI.conclusion: 低频声子的异常行为可解释为声子-电子散射的贡献，表明在T$_d$-WTe$_2$中不同频率的声子模式受不同的散射机制主导。

title: Non-Hermitian control of helicity-selective antiferromagnetic resonance
summary: We study non-Hermitian antiferromagnetic resonance in an antiferromagnetic insulator/nonmagnetic metal junction with sublattice-dependent damping and spin-orbit torque. By formulating the linearized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation as a 2x2 non-Hermitian eigenvalue problem, we derive the complex resonance frequencies, the exceptional-point condition, and the stability-threshold condition. We show that the largest absorption response is maximized by approaching the stability threshold from the stable side. Near the threshold on the stable side, the absorption spectrum exhibits strong enhancement and linewidth narrowing, together with pronounced helicity dependence in the sub-THz regime that can be switched by reversing the spin-orbit torque. We also confirm by solving the full LLG dynamics that crossing the threshold leads to gain and self-oscillation. These results identify the stability threshold as the key control principle for enhancing absorption and achieving polarization selectivity in the sub-THz/THz regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了反铁磁绝缘体/非磁金属异质结中非厄密反铁磁共振现象，通过将线性化LLG方程建模为2x2非厄密本征值问题，导出复共振频率、异常点条件和稳定性阈值条件，发现靠近稳定阈值时吸收谱显著增强且线宽变窄，并表现出可被自旋轨道转矩反转的强螺旋度依赖性，证明了稳定性阈值是增强亚THz/THz波段吸收和实现偏振选择性的关键控制原理。
AI.motivation: 传统反铁磁共振研究中通常假设均匀阻尼，忽略了反铁磁体系中不同磁子晶格可能具有不同阻尼和自旋轨道转矩的实际情况。本文旨在建立更普适的非厄密反铁磁共振理论框架，揭示稳定性阈值在增强吸收和实现偏振选择性中的核心作用。
AI.method: 将线性化Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG)方程构造为2x2非厄密本征值问题，解析推导复共振频率、异常点条件和稳定性阈值条件；通过求解完整LLG动力学验证稳定性阈值穿越行为。
AI.result: 1) 稳定性阈值附近（稳定侧）吸收谱出现大幅增强和线宽变窄现象；2) 吸收表现出显著的螺旋度依赖性，可通过反转自旋轨道转矩进行切换；3) 穿越稳定性阈值后系统进入增益和自持振荡状态。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性阈值被识别为增强亚THz/THz波段吸收和实现偏振选择性的关键控制原理，为设计高性能反铁磁太赫兹器件提供了理论指导。

title: Ethaline deep eutectic solvent under nanoconfinement: Unveiling structural and dynamical changes
comment: To appear in The Journal of Chemical Physics
summary: Hybrid nanomaterials incorporating deep eutectic solvents (DES) in porous hosts or at solid interfaces are gaining increasing attention for their potential interest across a wide range of applications. Under these conditions, the performances of DESs may be influenced by interfacial effects and spatial restrictions. In this study, we examined the effects of nanoconfinement on both the structure and molecular dynamics of the prototypical DES ethaline (a mixture of choline chloride and ethylene glycol) when confined within the cylindrical mesopores of SBA-15 (Dp $\approx$ 8.1 nm) and MCM-41 (Dp $\approx$ 3.5 nm) silicas, using neutron diffraction and quasielastic neutron scattering. It demonstrates that ethaline remains structurally homogeneous under confinement, showing no evidence of core-shell segregation within the pore cross-section. The molecular dynamics of the confined ethaline preserve the key characteristics observed in its bulk state. Translational diffusion follows a jump-diffusion mechanism, with diffusion coefficients that remain remarkably close to the bulk values, showing only a modest reduction in MCM-41. A more pronounced increase in the residence time t0 between translational molecular jumps is observed. It corresponds to roughly a factor of 3-8 under confinement in SBA-15, and reaches up to a tenfold enhancement in MCM-41 relative to bulk. Similarly, the characteristic relaxation time, tL, associated with the localized in-cage motion of ethaline, increases by approximately 20% in SBA-15 and up to 50% in MCM-41. However, the molecular trajectories, modeled from the elastic incoherent structure factor, remain largely preserved under confinement, showing only a marginal reduction in intra-basin motional amplitudes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了深共晶溶剂乙二醇-氯化胆碱（ethaline）在SBA-15（~8.1 nm）和MCM-41（~3.5 nm）介孔二氧化硅中的纳米限域效应。中子衍射和准弹性中子散射结果表明，限域下ethaline保持结构均匀，无核壳分离；分子动力学保留体相特征，扩散系数与体相接近，但在MCM-41中略有下降；分子跳跃停留时间在SBA-15中增大3-8倍，在MCM-41中增大至10倍；笼内局域弛豫时间增大20%-50%；分子轨迹基本保持，振幅略有减小。
AI.motivation: 深共晶溶剂（DES）在限域环境（多孔宿主或固液界面）中性能可能受到界面效应和空间限制的影响，但目前对纳米限域如何影响DES的结构和分子动力学认识不足，因此需要系统研究限域效应。
AI.method: 采用中子衍射和准弹性中子散射技术，将典型DES ethaline（氯化胆碱+乙二醇）分别限域在孔径约8.1 nm的SBA-15和孔径约3.5 nm的MCM-41介孔二氧化硅中，系统表征其结构和分子动力学。
AI.result: 1) 限域下ethaline保持结构均匀，无核壳分离；2) 扩散系数与体相接近，MCM-41中略有下降；3) 分子跳跃停留时间在SBA-15中增大3-8倍，MCM-41中高达10倍；4) 局域笼内弛豫时间增大20%-50%；5) 分子轨迹基本保留，运动振幅略有减小。
AI.conclusion: 纳米限域对ethaline的宏观结构和扩散系数影响有限，但对分子跳跃的停留时间和局域弛豫动力学有显著增强效应，且孔径越小（MCM-41）效应越明显，说明空间限制主要影响分子尺度的运动节律而非整体扩散能力。

title: Unveiling Nanoscale Surface Damage Dynamics in Swift Heavy Ion Irradiated Gallium Nitride
summary: This work systematically unveils the nanoscale surface damage dynamics in gallium nitride by investigating the atomistic mechanisms of hillock formation. The results identify two distinct hillock morphologies dependent on electronic energy loss (Se) values. Bell-shaped hillocks form under 18.2 keV/nm Kr irradiation, whereas crater-rim hillocks with central holes emerge under 40.2 keV/nm Ta irradiation. Microstructural analysis reveals that Ga-rich hillocks are accompanied by the generation of metastable zincblende nanodomains. These nanodomains preferentially aggregate around the periphery or sidewalls of the hillocks and exhibit a high spatial correlation with screw dislocations. Further temperature-dependent studies indicate that elevated temperatures significantly enlarge the overall dimensions of the hillock structures without altering their fundamental morphologies. Notably, under Ta irradiation above 1200 K, the high temperatures drastically reduce the viscosity and surface tension of liquid gallium. This enhanced fluidity of the transient molten phase promotes the formation of penetrating nanochannels.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统揭示了GaN纳米尺度表面损伤动力学，阐明了不同电子能损下两种山丘形态（Kr辐照下的钟形山丘和Ta辐照下的坑缘山丘）的形成机制，发现富Ga山丘伴随亚稳态闪锌矿纳米域生成，高温下液态Ga粘度和表面张力降低促进穿透性纳米通道形成。
AI.motivation: 探究GaN在离子辐照下纳米尺度表面损伤的原子机制，特别是不同电子能损（Se）条件下山丘结构形成的微观机理。
AI.method: 通过对18.2 keV/nm Kr和40.2 keV/nm Ta辐照下的GaN进行微观结构分析，结合温度依赖性实验，研究山丘形貌、成分分布和缺陷结构。
AI.result: 识别出两种山丘形貌：Kr辐照下为钟形山丘，Ta辐照下为带中心孔的坑缘山丘；富Ga山丘伴随闪锌矿纳米域生成，且与螺位错高度相关；高温（>1200 K）可显著增大山丘尺寸并促进纳米通道形成。
AI.conclusion: 电子能损值决定山丘形态，高温通过降低液态Ga的粘度和表面张力增强熔体流动性，从而改变损伤结构，为理解GaN辐照损伤机制提供了原子尺度见解。

title: Interplay of Umklapp scattering and Sb-Au hybridization in surface-reconstructed Sb/Au(111)
summary: Surface reconstructions induced by atomic adsorption can strongly reshape metallic surface states, providing a direct pathway to tune their electronic structure. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we investigate the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) during the coverage-driven evolution from the clean Au(111) surface to the $(14\times14)$ and Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phases. In the Rec$(3\times\sqrt{3})$ phase, triangular Fermi pockets emerge at the Brillouin-zone boundary. Their momentum positions are consistent with a reciprocal-space folding construction, but their reduced size near the Fermi level indicates a modification of the Au-derived $sp$ dispersion. The substantial modifications of deeper Au $d$-derived bands observed in ARPES further indicate significant mixing between Sb $p$ orbitals and Au $d$ states. These results show that the electronic structure of Sb/Au(111) is governed by the interplay between reconstruction-induced Umklapp scattering and interfacial orbital hybridization, highlighting adsorbate-substrate hybridization as a key mechanism for tuning and engineering surface electronic structures.

AI.tldr: 本文利用角分辨光电子能谱研究Sb吸附在Au(111)表面的电子结构演化，发现从清洁Au(111)到(14×14)和Rec(3×√3)相的过程中，重构诱导的Umklapp散射和界面轨道杂化共同决定了电子结构，特别是Rec(3×√3)相中布里渊区边界出现三角形费米口袋，且Sb p轨道与Au d态存在显著杂化。
AI.motivation: 研究原子吸附诱导的表面重构如何调节金属表面态电子结构，探索通过吸附物-基底杂化来工程化表面电子结构的机制。
AI.method: 使用角分辨光电子能谱(ARPES)实验技术，系统测量Sb/Au(111)体系在不同覆盖度下的电子结构演化，从清洁表面到(14×14)相再到Rec(3×√3)相。
AI.result: Rec(3×√3)相中在布里渊区边界出现三角形费米口袋；费米口袋的动量位置符合倒空间折叠构造，但在费米能级附近尺寸减小表明Au的sp色散被修改；ARPES观察到深层的Au d衍生带发生显著变化，证实Sb p轨道与Au d态之间存在杂化。
AI.conclusion: Sb/Au(111)的电子结构由重构诱导的Umklapp散射和界面轨道杂化共同主导，吸附物-基底杂化是调控和工程化表面电子结构的关键机制。

title: Terahertz Phase Inversion via Field-Free Spin-Orbit Torque Switching in an Antenna-Integrated Spintronic Heterostructure
summary: We demonstrate microsecond-timescale electrical control of the terahertz (THz) emission phase in broadband field-free spintronic THz emitters, enabling megahertz-rate phase inversion while overcoming the kilohertz limitations of conventional mechanical and field-driven approaches. Our device integrates an H-dipole antenna with a spintronic heterostructure exhibiting uniaxial magnetic anisotropy, enabling deterministic spin-orbit torque induced in-plane magnetization switching without external magnetic fields. The corresponding THz phase inversion is directly observed in the time domain signal, by applying $1\,μ\mathrm{s}$ electrical pulses on the bias striplines of the H-dipole. This field-free operation reduces system complexity while significantly extending modulation bandwidth. Our results establish electrically programmable spintronic THz emitters that could be used to develop a compact and scalable platform for integrated on-chip THz devices and ultrafast applications, including phase-sensitive spectroscopy and near-field imaging, where high-speed and precise control of THz waveforms is essential.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了对宽带无磁场自旋太赫兹发射器的微秒级电控相位反转，通过H-dipole天线与自旋异质结构集成，实现无需外磁场的确定性磁化切换，将调制带宽从千赫兹提升至兆赫兹级别。
AI.motivation: 传统太赫兹相位控制方法（机械或场驱动方式）受限于千赫兹级别的调制带宽，且系统复杂。本文旨在开发一种高速、紧凑、可电编程的解决方案，实现微秒级太赫兹相位控制。
AI.method: 将H-dipole天线与具有单轴磁各向异性的自旋异质结构集成，利用自旋轨道矩在无外磁场条件下实现确定性面内磁化翻转，通过施加1微秒电脉冲控制偏置带状线来实现太赫兹相位反转。
AI.result: 成功实现了微秒级时间尺度的太赫兹发射相位电控反转，调制速率达到兆赫兹级别，直接在时域信号中观测到相位反转，并消除了对外部磁场的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 建立了电可编程的自旋太赫兹发射器平台，为片上集成太赫兹器件和超快应用（如相敏光谱学、近场成像）提供了紧凑、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Understanding surface potential dynamics of passivated perovskites via Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
summary: Molecular passivation has become central to reducing photovoltage losses in metal-halide perovskite solar cells, but its electronic action is still often inferred from device-level metrics rather than directly resolved at the nanoscale. Here, we use amplitude-modulated Kelvin probe force microscopy to examine how [3-(2-aminoethylamino)propyl]trimethoxysilane (AEAPTMS) modifies the surface potential and photovoltage dynamics of mixed-cation, mixed-halide perovskite thin films. AEAPTMS homogenises the dark contact potential difference (CPD), narrowing its distribution from ~45.7 to ~14.6 mV without obvious morphological changes. Under illumination, passivated films show a larger steady-state surface photovoltage (SPV) and faster stabilisation, with the SPV increasing from ~345 to ~417 mV and the stabilisation time constant decreasing from ~840 to ~470 s. Wavelength-dependent SPV further indicates reduced sub-bandgap electronic disorder. By separating grain-boundary and grain-interior contributions, we show that AEAPTMS suppresses grain-boundary potential barriers, linking amino-silane passivation to a more homogeneous and stable carrier landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文利用振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜，研究了[3-(2-氨基乙基氨基)丙基]三甲氧基硅烷（AEAPTMS）对混合阳离子、混合卤化物钙钛矿薄膜的表面电势和光电压动力学的影响。AEAPTMS使暗态接触电势差分布从~45.7 mV缩小至~14.6 mV，稳态表面光电压从~345 mV增至~417 mV，稳定时间常数从~840 s降至~470 s，并减少了亚带隙电子无序，抑制了晶界势垒。
AI.motivation: 分子钝化对减少金属卤化物钙钛矿太阳能电池的光电压损失至关重要，但其电子作用通常从器件层面推断，缺乏纳米尺度的直接解析。本文旨在通过纳米级表征手段直接揭示AEAPTMS钝化对钙钛矿薄膜表面电势和光电压动力学的调控机制。
AI.method: 使用振幅调制开尔文探针力显微镜（AM-KPFM）对AEAPTMS处理的混合阳离子、混合卤化物钙钛矿薄膜进行表面电势和光电压动力学测量，分析暗态CPD分布、稳态SPV、稳定时间常数、波长依赖SPV，并分离晶界与晶粒内部贡献。
AI.result: AEAPTMS使暗态CPD分布从~45.7 mV收窄至~14.6 mV；稳态SPV从~345 mV提升至~417 mV；稳定时间常数从~840 s降至~470 s；波长依赖SPV显示亚带隙电子无序减少；晶界势垒被抑制。
AI.conclusion: AEAPTMS钝化通过抑制晶界势垒、减少电子无序，实现了更均匀稳定的载流子景观，从而提升了钙钛矿薄膜的光电性能。

title: Improving feature resolution and pore back effect in focused ion beam tomography of porous GaN thin films
summary: Porous gallium nitride (GaN) is a mesoporous crystalline material, typically in the form of a thin film on an unlike substrate, prepared by electrochemically etching conductive GaN. The use of porous GaN in electronics and optoelectronics is rapidly expanding, but is held back significantly by a lack of structural control and understanding of the principles of pore formation from underlying electrochemical mechanisms, where high-quality characterisation of pore morphology is essential to understanding these principles. Focused ion beam (FIB) tomography is an invaluable tool for such characterisation, but is hindered greatly by the pore back effect, where unwanted contrast appears in an image due to electrons scattering out from the back wall of a pore. No major attempts to formally quantify or assess the extent of the effect for different tomography experiments has been demonstrated. In this work, we demonstrate an advanced methodology for performing FIB tomography on porous GaN thin films, where the experiment is rotated to image pores perpendicular to the surface of the sample, and introduce new voxel intensity-based formalisms for assessing the impact of the pore back effect based on voxel intensities for individual features and the whole dataset. The new approach, which requires more complex preliminary setup, is found to significantly mitigate the pore back effect in porous GaN thin films with a range of pore morphologies without increasing the total experimental duration. The pore back effect can thus be quantified and mitigated in FIB tomography of porous GaN and similar mesoporous thin films.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多孔氮化镓（GaN）薄膜的FIB断层扫描中存在的“孔隙背向效应”（pore back effect）问题，提出了一种改进的实验方法（旋转样品使孔隙垂直于表面成像），并引入基于体素强度的量化评估指标。该方法在不增加实验时间的前提下显著抑制了孔隙背向效应，适用于多种孔隙形态，为多孔GaN及类似介孔薄膜的精确表征提供了有效方案。
AI.motivation: 多孔GaN在电子和光电子领域应用广泛，但其结构控制和成孔原理理解受限于缺乏高质量孔隙形态表征。FIB断层扫描是重要表征工具，但“孔隙背向效应”（电子从孔后壁散射产生伪影）严重干扰成像，且此前缺乏对该效应的系统量化评估与缓解方法。
AI.method: 提出旋转实验方案，将样品旋转使孔隙垂直于表面进行FIB断层扫描成像；同时引入基于体素强度的新形式化方法，分别针对单个特征和整个数据集量化孔隙背向效应的影响。
AI.result: 新方法虽需更复杂的前期准备，但能显著缓解多孔GaN薄膜中不同孔隙形态下的孔隙背向效应，且不增加总实验时间。
AI.conclusion: 本文实现了对FIB断层扫描中孔隙背向效应的量化与缓解，方法可推广至多孔GaN及其他类似介孔薄膜材料。

title: Bayesian Optimization of Genetic Algorithm Hyperparameters in a Multi-Fidelity Framework for Efficient Lattice Material Design
summary: This study presents a multi-fidelity framework for the systematic optimization of genetic algorithm (GA) hyperparameters. The framework integrates three fidelity levels: high-fidelity Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) homogenization for validation, a medium-fidelity 3D convolutional neural network surrogate for rapid property evaluation, and a low-fidelity Gaussian process (GP) surrogate within a Bayesian optimization (BO) framework to guide the hyperparameter search. Various acquisition functions are evaluated, with logNEI achieving the best performance by effectively accounting for the noise inherent in GA evaluations. The proposed framework identifies hyperparameter configurations that enable a 25-generation GA run to achieve elastic modulus values comparable to those obtained in a full 75-generation optimization. Furthermore, introducing a penalized BO objective significantly reduces the number of required lattices with only minor decreases in absolute achieved elastic modulus, revealing a practical trade-off between performance and the number of structures that must be evaluated. High-fidelity FFT validation verifies the effectiveness of the surrogate-driven optimization strategy. The optimized hyperparameters allow for rapid convergence, eliminate the need for lattice mutation, and reduce the overall computational cost by 24% (from 225 to 171 hours) while preserving mechanical performance. These results demonstrate the potential of multi-fidelity optimization as an efficient and practical approach for GA hyperparameter tuning and future experimental lattice design studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多保真度框架，系统优化遗传算法（GA）超参数。该框架结合三种保真度级别：高保真FFT均匀化、中保真3D卷积神经网络代理、低保真高斯过程代理（用于贝叶斯优化）。评估多种采集函数，logNEI表现最佳。优化后，25代GA达到75代的弹性模量性能，计算成本降低24%（从225小时降至171小时），且无需晶格突变。
AI.motivation: 遗传算法超参数优化通常依赖经验或穷举搜索，计算成本高昂且效率低下。现有方法缺乏系统性的多保真度框架来平衡精度与效率，亟需一种能显著降低计算开销同时保持优化性能的自动化超参数调优方案。
AI.method: 构建三保真度框架：高保真（FFT均匀化验证）、中保真（3D CNN代理快速评估）、低保真（GP代理嵌入贝叶斯优化）。采用logNEI采集函数处理GA评估噪声，并引入惩罚BO目标以权衡性能与结构数量。
AI.result: 优化后的超参数使25代GA达到75代GA的弹性模量性能；计算成本降低24%（225→171小时）；消除晶格突变需求；惩罚BO目标在轻微牺牲性能的前提下显著减少所需晶格数量。
AI.conclusion: 多保真度优化是一种高效、实用的GA超参数调优方法，可推广至未来的实验晶格设计研究，在保持力学性能的同时大幅降低计算成本。

title: A Topotactic Phase Transition in the Uranium Oxide System
summary: A topotactic phase transition involves the transformation of one crystalline solid to another, which may include the loss or gain of material, where the orientation of the parent crystal determines the orientation of the daughter. We set out an experimental approach, based on polyepitaxial thin film deposition, where the precise transformation mechanism in important physico-chemical processes can be revealed in brilliant detail. Here, we find a reversible topotactic transition from (001) cubic UO2 to a (130) orthorhombic U3O8 structure; a >35% expansion/contraction. This remarkable result solves a puzzle that has eluded researchers for decades, and presents a method for determining the mechanism of crystallographic transformation in many other compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多外延薄膜沉积方法，揭示了UO₂到U₃O₈的可逆拓扑相变机制，解决了长期未解的晶体学难题。
AI.motivation: 长期以来，UO₂到U₃O₈的相变机制一直未能被清晰解释，传统方法难以精确揭示晶体取向关系与转变路径。
AI.method: 采用多外延薄膜沉积实验方法，通过控制取向关系，实时观察从(001)立方UO₂到(130)正交U₃O₈的可逆拓扑相变过程。
AI.result: 发现了UO₂与U₃O₈之间存在超过35%的体积膨胀/收缩的可逆拓扑相变，且母晶取向精确决定了子晶取向。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅解决了UO₂→U₃O₈相变数十年的谜题，还提供了一种通用的实验方法，可用于研究其他化合物的晶体学转变机制。

title: Electrical manipulation and detection of perpendicular altermagnetic order via proximitized Dirac semimetal
summary: Altermagnets, which combine antiferromagnetic-like magnetic compensation with ferromagnetic-like broken time-reversal symmetry, hold great promise for high-density and ultrafast spintronic applications. However, the detection and switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order are fundamentally constrained by magnetic symmetry, restricting both fundamental studies and practical implementation. We realize robust electrical reading and deterministic switching of perpendicular altermagnetic order by designing a Dirac semimetal/altermagnet heterostructure of PtTe2/CrSb. This engineered interface enables anomalous Hall readout via altermagnetic proximity effect and delivers efficient spin-orbit torque for manipulating the epitaxial perpendicular Neel vector in CrSb. These findings significantly broaden the functional scope of altermagnetic heterostructures and pave the way for highly scalable altermagnetic memory.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在狄拉克半金属/交变磁体异质结（PtTe2/CrSb）中实现垂直交变磁序的电学读出和确定性翻转，解决了交变磁体在高密度超快自旋电子学应用中的关键限制。
AI.motivation: 垂直交变磁序的探测和翻转受限于磁对称性，阻碍了基础研究和实际应用。现有方法难以实现高效的垂直交变磁序电学操控，需要新的异质结构设计来突破这一限制。
AI.method: 设计PtTe2/CrSb狄拉克半金属/交变磁体异质结，利用交变磁邻近效应实现反常霍尔读出，并通过自旋轨道矩操纵外延垂直奈尔矢量。
AI.result: 实现了垂直交变磁序的鲁棒电学读出和确定性翻转，展示了高效的界面自旋轨道矩操控能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓宽了交变磁异质结的功能范围，为高可扩展性交变磁存储器件奠定了基础。

title: Machine Learning Materials Properties by Encoding Orbital-Projected Density of States
summary: Graph neural networks have become the dominant machine-learning architecture for predicting materials properties from crystal structures. Yet the initialization of atomic node features has received comparatively little attention, and conventional approaches rely on static elemental descriptors that carry no information about the quantum-mechanical electronic environment of each atom in its crystalline host. Here we show that augmenting atomic node representations with site-projected orbital density of states (pDOS) fingerprints, computed directly from density functional theory calculations, yields systematic and substantial improvements in predictive performance.These representations are fused with Pettifor elemental embeddings at each atomic site before message passing. For the superconducting critical temperature $T_c$ and the optical dielectric constant $ε_{\infty}$,the pDOS augmentation reduces prediction errors by 22.9% and 27.9%, respectively, relative to the elemental-descriptor baseline. These improvements are comparable to those achieved by doubling the training-set size. The gains are, however, contingent on training-set size. For the magnetic exchange energies of Heusler compounds, a substantially smaller dataset, the improvement is reduced,indicating that pDOS augmentation is most effective when the training data exceeds the length of the pDOS feature vector. We introduce an interpretable spectral attention-gating mechanism that reveals that the model autonomously learns to prioritize the orbital channels and energy windows most physically relevant to each target property. These results establish pDOS-augmented graph nodes as a broadly applicable strategy for infusing first-principles electronic-structure knowledge into graph networks, opening a practical route to high-accuracy property prediction in data-scarce regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用第一性原理计算的投影轨道态密度（pDOS）增强图神经网络原子节点特征，在超导临界温度和光学介电常数预测上分别降低误差22.9%和27.9%，效果堪比训练集翻倍，并引入可解释的谱注意力机制揭示模型自主学习了物理相关的轨道和能量窗口。
AI.motivation: 传统图神经网络初始化原子节点特征时使用静态元素描述符，缺乏原子在晶体中量子力学电子环境的信息，限制了预测性能。
AI.method: 将DFT计算的pDOS指纹与Pettifor元素嵌入融合作为原子节点特征，在消息传递前使用谱注意力门控机制，让模型自主学习优先关注与目标性质物理相关的轨道通道和能量窗口。
AI.result: 超导临界温度Tc预测误差降低22.9%，光学介电常数ε∞预测误差降低27.9%，效果相当于训练集规模翻倍；在较小的Heusler化合物数据集上改进幅度减小，表明pDOS增强在训练数据超过pDOS特征向量长度时最有效。
AI.conclusion: pDOS增强图节点是一种将第一性原理电子结构知识融入图网络的通用策略，为数据稀缺场景下的高精度性质预测提供了实用路径。

title: Optimizing high-temperature electron mobility in single-crystal Bi$_2$O$_2$Se based on its unconventional dependence on concentration
comment: Manuscript (13 pages, 6 figures) and Supplementary material (17 pages, 16 figures)
summary: Quasi-2D Bi$_2$O$_2$Se is part of an intensive materials research effort aimed at finding new semiconductors that outperform silicon-based electronics in terms of speed and power consumption. This material exhibits exceptionally high carrier mobility at low temperatures but mediocre mobility at 300 K. Its high mobility is generally associated with its high permittivity ($\varepsilon_r$~500), which is also associated with metallicity persisting down to very low carrier concentrations. This material exhibits a counterintuitive increase in carrier mobility as the concentration increases. The connection between low both carrier concentration and mobility in Se-rich conditions, and both high carrier concentration and mobility in Se-poor conditions suggests that the increase is related to native defects. We demonstrate that these defects can alter the effective mass of charge carriers. Specifically, substitutional Se(Bi) defects, which appear under Se-rich conditions, destroy the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel and compromise charge transport properties. These defects increase the effective mass of charge carriers transforming the original semiconductor into a semimetal and introducing holes into charge transport. Additionally, we show that single crystals are generally inhomogeneous, particularly those grown under Se-rich conditions. Unlike Se-poor conditions, Se-rich conditions induce a higher concentration of dislocations and extraneous phases. These findings suggest that the perfection of the Bi$_2$O$_2$ channel is crucial for mobility, particularly at room temperature.

AI.tldr: 准二维Bi₂O₂Se在低温下具有超高载流子迁移率，但室温下性能平庸。研究发现，Se-rich条件下产生的替代缺陷Se(Bi)会破坏Bi₂O₂通道、增加有效质量并引入空穴，而Se-poor条件下缺陷较少、迁移率更高。单晶不均匀性尤其是Se-rich条件下的位错和杂相对室温迁移率有显著影响。
AI.motivation: 寻找超越硅基电子器件性能的新半导体材料，理解Bi₂O₂Se中载流子迁移率随浓度增加的反直觉现象，揭示其物理机制。
AI.method: 通过对比Se-rich和Se-poor条件下的电学性能与缺陷特征，分析替代缺陷Se(Bi)对有效质量、能带结构和电荷传输的影响，结合单晶均匀性研究。
AI.result: Se(Bi)替代缺陷破坏Bi₂O₂通道，增加有效质量，使半导体转变为半金属并引入空穴参与传输；Se-rich条件下单晶不均匀性更高，存在更多位错和杂相。
AI.conclusion: Bi₂O₂通道的完整性是维持高迁移率的关键，尤其是室温下；缺陷工程（抑制Se(Bi)缺陷）是优化该材料室温电学性能的核心方向。

title: Growth of (111)-textured SrTiO3 thin films on Pt(111)/Al2O3(1-102) substrates by rf magnetron sputter deposition
summary: SrTiO3 thin films, 20-30nm, with high quality crystal structure and low roughness can be used as growth templates for complex oxides or as the dielectric materials for capacitor structures. In this work, stoichiometric STO thin films were grown by radio frequency magnetron sputtering on Pt (111) templates grown on rAl2O3 substrates, and the effects of growth parameters as well as the underlying Pt templates structural properties on the quality of STO films were studied. A comparison between room temp grown Pt and Pt grown at elevated temps showed that the latter lead to highly ordered Pt and STO films with quasi 2D surface roughness. Xray diffraction showed that the STO thin films had (111) and (222) crystal orientation. A rocking curve full width at half maximum value of 0.2° was achieved, indicating that the STO films are high-quality. The STO films have a roughness less than 1 nm, as measured using atomic force microscopy, comparable to the underlying Pt templates roughness.

AI.tldr: 本文通过射频磁控溅射在Pt(111)/r-Al2O3衬底上生长了高质量、低粗糙度的SrTiO₃薄膜，研究了生长参数和Pt模板对薄膜质量的影响，获得了(111)和(222)取向、摇摆曲线半高宽0.2°、粗糙度<1 nm的优质STO薄膜。
AI.motivation: SrTiO₃薄膜可作为复杂氧化物生长模板或电容器介质材料，但高质量STO薄膜的生长条件及底层Pt模板对其质量的影响尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 采用射频磁控溅射法在Pt(111)/r-Al₂O₃衬底上生长化学计量比的STO薄膜，对比室温与高温生长的Pt模板，利用X射线衍射和原子力显微镜表征薄膜的晶体结构和表面形貌。
AI.result: 高温生长的Pt模板可获得高度有序的Pt和STO薄膜，STO呈现(111)/(222)取向，摇摆曲线半高宽0.2°，粗糙度低于1 nm。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化生长条件和使用高温生长的Pt模板，可制备出晶体质量高、表面平整的STO薄膜，其粗糙度与底层Pt模板相当。

title: A Multi-Scale Machine Learning Framework for Coupled Chemical, Spin, and Structural Disorder in Alloys
summary: Understanding the thermodynamic properties of disordered magnetic alloys requires a unified treatment of configurational (chemical, spin, etc.) and structural degrees of freedom, which has remained beyond the scope of existing computational frameworks. Here we present a general framework that integrates machine learning models (such as graph neural networks and machine learning interatomic potentials) and statistical sampling methods (such as Monte Carlo and molecular dynamics simulations) to study the coupled chemical, spin, and structural disorder in alloys. We demonstrate the framework on body-centered-cubic Fe-Co alloys with interstitial carbon dopants, where the Fe-Co host exhibits intrinsic chemical and spin disorder, and the interstitial carbon introduces additional structural disorder through local lattice distortions, making the system a prototypical multi-disorder magnetic alloy. The framework predicts the order-to-disorder phase transition temperature and the melting temperature of Fe-Co alloy to be 1,000 K and 1,690 K, in excellent agreement with the experimentally measured values of 1,006 K and approximately 1,700 K, respectively. It also predicts the tetragonal-to-nearly-cubic structural transitions in Fe-Co-C alloy as temperature increases. These results establish the framework as a reliable tool for studying multi-disorder alloys, with applications to complex disordered systems such as high-entropy alloys, multiferroics, and spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一处理磁性合金中化学、自旋和结构无序的计算框架，结合机器学习模型和统计采样方法，在Fe-Co-C合金中成功预测了相变温度与结构转变，与实验高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 现有计算框架无法统一处理磁性合金中化学、自旋和结构等多重无序的热力学性质，亟需一种能够同时耦合这些自由度的方法。
AI.method: 将机器学习模型（图神经网络、机器学习原子间势）与统计采样方法（蒙特卡洛、分子动力学模拟）相结合，统一处理合金中的化学、自旋和结构无序。
AI.result: 框架预测Fe-Co合金的有序-无序相变温度（1,000 K）和熔化温度（1,690 K），与实验值（1,006 K和约1,700 K）高度一致；同时预测了Fe-Co-C合金随温度增加的四方到近立方结构转变。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是研究多重无序合金的可靠工具，可推广到高熵合金、多铁材料和自旋电子器件等复杂无序系统。

title: Stress calculation in linear scaling DFT: convergence and dynamics
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, submitted to J. Phys.:Condens. Matter
summary: We present the approach needed to calculate stress within density functional theory (DFT) using a localised orbital basis, both for exact diagonalisation and linear scaling approaches, and demonstrate our implementation within the large scale DFT code Conquest. For the linear scaling approach, we test the rate of convergence of stress with density matrix range, and compare it to the convergence of energy and forces for different materials with a range of band gaps. We show that excellent convergence is found for modest cutoffs, and show that large-scale isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics is stable and accurate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了在密度泛函理论(DFT)中使用局域轨道基组计算应力的方法，涵盖精确对角化和线性标度两种途径，并在大规模DFT代码Conquest中实现。研究表明，对于不同带隙的材料，应力随密度矩阵范围的收敛速度与能量和力的收敛相当，在适度截断下即可获得优异收敛，且大规模等温等压分子动力学稳定准确。
AI.motivation: 在局域轨道基组的DFT框架下，应力的计算尚未得到充分发展，特别是对于线性标度方法。作者旨在填补这一空白，使大规模DFT模拟能够同时高效计算应力，从而支持等温等压分子动力学等应用。
AI.method: 在Conquest代码中，分别针对精确对角化和线性标度两种方法，推导并实现了局域轨道基组下应力的计算公式。通过测试不同带隙材料，系统评估了应力随密度矩阵截断范围的收敛行为，并与能量和力的收敛进行对比。
AI.result: 应力在适度密度矩阵截断下即可达到优异的收敛效果，其收敛速度与能量和力相当。大规模等温等压分子动力学模拟证明该方法稳定且准确。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将应力计算扩展到局域轨道基组的线性标度DFT框架中，验证了该方法的高效性和可靠性，为大规模材料模拟中的力学性质研究提供了实用工具。

title: Monolithic GaN Systems Combining Non-Volatile Memory and Analog Computing via Area-Ratio-Engineered Ferroelectric AlScN Gate Stacks
summary: Gallium nitride (GaN) transistors have become the platform of choice for power electronics and radio-frequency power amplifiers. To unlock capabilities beyond those of conventional GaN, integrating ferroelectric heterostructure has been considered toward memory, logic and reconfigurable systems. Here, we demonstrate ferroelectric GaN transistors employing an AlScN-based gate stack in which systematic engineering of the area-ratio (SMIS/SMFM) provides unified control over both memory and analog functionality. Precise modulation of the intermediate electrode length yields a record memory window of 27 V and a forward subthreshold swing of 27 mV/dec, driven by ferroelectric polarization reversal of a robust downward-polarization state pre-induced by two-dimensional electron gas. Low area-ratio devices (SMIS/SMFM = 1, 2) achieve 4-bit multi-level cell operation and excellent spatial uniformity across a fabricated 4 x 4 array, benchmarking favorably against established silicon and oxide ferroelectric architectures. High area-ratio devices (SMIS/SMFM = 4, 8) harness continuously tunable conductance states to demonstrate multi-state inverters and the first GaN-based ferroelectric frequency-to-voltage converter, delivering a linear frequency-voltage response across 0.5 - 500 Hz range with a conversion gain of 1.1 mV/Hz. This work establishes routes towards monolithically integrated GaN systems that combine non-volatile memory and analog signal processing on a platform inherently suited to high-power and radio-frequency applications.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了基于AlScN栅叠层的铁电氮化镓晶体管，通过面积比(SMIS/SMFM)工程实现了存储与模拟功能的统一调控，创下了27V存储窗口和27mV/dec亚阈值摆幅的记录，并首次实现了GaN基铁电频率-电压转换器。
AI.motivation: 传统GaN晶体管在高功率和射频领域已取得巨大成功，但缺乏铁电集成带来的存储、逻辑和可重构能力。本文旨在通过铁电GaN晶体管的设计，将非易失性存储和模拟信号处理功能集成到GaN平台上。
AI.method: 采用AlScN基栅叠层结构，通过系统设计中间电极长度来调控面积比(SMIS/SMFM)。低面积比器件利用2DEG预诱导的稳健向下极化态实现存储功能；高面积比器件利用连续可调电导状态实现模拟功能。
AI.result: 实现了创纪录的27V存储窗口和27mV/dec亚阈值摆幅；低面积比器件(SMIS/SMFM=1,2)实现4-bit多级存储及优异的4x4阵列均匀性；高面积比器件(SMIS/SMFM=4,8)首次实现GaN基铁电频率-电压转换器，在0.5-500Hz范围内线性响应，转换增益1.1mV/Hz。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为在高功率和射频应用中实现单片集成GaN系统（兼具非易失性存储和模拟信号处理能力）开辟了可行路径。

title: Human and LLM Collaboration for Accelerated Materials Synthesis and Discovery
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools have enabled a rapid increase in the generation rate of predicted materials, the rate of new materials discovery has lagged behind. This is due to the challenges associated with designing a sequence of chemical reactions to predictably produce new materials, especially in new structure types. Here, we report a study of human and LLM generated recipes for the synthesis of known and new materials. The success of the recipes is determined through in-lab experimentation, and the results are passed back to the humans and LLMs in a closed-loop process to study the effects of their collaboration. The Ruddlesden-Popper homologous series was selected for all material candidates to provide a materials phase space that is simultaneously well studied and likely to host undiscovered materials. We find that humans (H) and LLM (L) have similar success rates: 83(8)% (H) and 75(9)% (L) [known materials, round one], 17(9)% (H) and 22(10)% (L) [unknown materials, round one], 79(8)% (H) and 71(9)% (L) [known materials, round two], and 22(7)% (H) and 14(6)% (L) [unknown materials, round two]. Through this collaborative human-LLM effort, we discovered Ba3PtO5, a material with a new structural prototype that constitutes the missing 1D member of the herein reported dimensionally tunable Rock-Salt Perovskite (RSP) homologous series of the form (AX)m(ABX3)p, of which the Ruddlesden-Popper series is a subset.

AI.tldr: 人类与LLM在合成已知和新型材料上的成功率相近。通过人机协作，发现了一种具有新结构原型的材料Ba3PtO5，属于新的Rock-Salt Perovskite（RSP）同源系列。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM和AI工具加速了材料预测，但新材料发现率仍滞后，主要瓶颈在于设计化学反应路线来可预测地合成新结构类型的材料。本文旨在研究人类与LLM在材料合成配方设计上的协作效果。
AI.method: 在Ruddlesden-Popper同源系列中，人类和LLM分别设计已知和未知材料的合成配方，通过闭环实验验证配方的成功率，并将结果反馈给人类和LLM以研究协作效果。
AI.result: 人类和LLM在已知材料合成成功率上接近（~80%），未知材料成功率也相近（~20%）。通过人机协作发现了Ba3PtO5，一种具有新结构原型的材料，属于(AX)m(ABX3)p形式的RSP同源系列。
AI.conclusion: 人类和LLM在材料合成配方设计上的表现相当，且人机协作能够促进新材料发现，展示了AI辅助材料合成的前景。

title: MLIP Studio: An Open Platform for Interactive Benchmarking and Atomistic Simulations Using Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are foundation AI models transforming atomistic simulations, but their practical use remains hindered by fragmented software ecosystems, dependency conflicts, and the lack of accessible benchmarking tools. These models approach first-principles density functional theory (DFT) accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. We introduce MLIP Studio (available at https://mlipstudio.iisc.ac.in), an open and free platform that brings more than 60 universal MLIPs into a unified interactive interface for molecules and materials. The platform enables end-to-end MLIP-driven workflows, including property prediction, geometry optimization, vibrational and equation-of-state analysis, spin-state determination, custom model deployment, and high-throughput benchmarking against reference data. Automated parity plots and sortable error tables facilitate rapid identification of element-wise outliers and problematic data points. We demonstrate that MLIP-based pre-optimization can reduce subsequent DFT optimization effort by ~33$\times$. Additionally, the application enables benchmarking of computational performance. Through a comprehensive case study involving the 2D magnetic material CrCl$_3$ on a sapphire substrate, we show how cross-model comparisons of various properties and potential-energy landscapes can guide task-specific MLIP selection. Overall, MLIP Studio lowers the barrier to the reliable use of foundation models in end-to-end research workflows, benchmarking, and education in computational chemistry and materials science.

AI.tldr: MLIP Studio是一个统一集成60+通用机器学习原子间势能模型(MLIPs)的开源交互平台，支持从性质预测到高通量基准测试的端到端工作流，显著降低了DFT优化成本(~33倍)，并通过案例研究展示了跨模型对比指导任务特定模型选择的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用MLIPs虽能以较低计算成本达到接近DFT的精度，但其实际应用受到软件生态碎片化、依赖冲突以及缺乏可访问的基准测试工具等问题的严重阻碍。
AI.method: 开发了一个统一的交互式平台MLIP Studio，集成了60+通用MLIPs，提供性质预测、几何优化、振动分析、状态方程分析、自旋态确定、自定义模型部署以及高通量基准测试等端到端工作流，并配备自动化的奇偶图和可排序误差表用于快速识别异常数据。
AI.result: 1) 基于MLIP的预优化可将后续DFT优化计算量减少约33倍；2) 以2D磁性材料CrCl₃在蓝宝石基底上的案例研究展示了跨模型属性对比和势能面分析如何指导任务特定模型选择。
AI.conclusion: MLIP Studio降低了在计算化学和材料科学的端到端研究流程、基准测试和教育中可靠使用基础模型的门槛。

title: Acoustic-phonon-driven spin-lattice relaxation of the hBN boron vacancy in the sub-THz regime
summary: The negatively charged boron vacancy center in hexagonal boron nitride is a premier candidate for quantum sensing, yet its performance is critically limited by longitudinal spin-lattice relaxation time ($T_1$). A microscopic understanding of spin relaxation in the high magnetic field regime remains elusive, as the relevant Zeeman transitions lie far below the optical phonon energies typically invoked to describe the relaxation process. Here, we apply an \textit{ab initio} acoustic mode spin-phonon relaxation theory to this problem and quantitatively reproduce the experimental magnetic field and temperature dependence of $T_1$ without empirical fitting parameters. We demonstrate that the relaxation dynamics are driven by a direct one-phonon emission and absorption process resonant with the Zeeman splitting. Furthermore, we identify the out-of-plane flexural phonon branch which is unique to two-dimensional hosts, as the primary source of decoherence, creating a distinct low-energy spectral function that facilitates spin relaxation. Our results provide a microscopic interpretation of the experimentally observed non-monotonic field and temperature dependence in two-dimensional quantum defect centers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理声子自旋弛豫理论，定量解释了六方氮化硼中硼空位色心在强磁场下的自旋-晶格弛豫时间(T1)的温度和磁场依赖关系，发现二维材料特有的面外弯曲声子支是导致自旋弛豫的主要机制。
AI.motivation: 硼空位色心是量子传感的优良候选，但其自旋-晶格弛豫时间(T1)严重限制其性能。高磁场下自旋弛豫的微观机制尚不清晰，因为相关的塞曼跃迁能量远低于通常用于描述弛豫过程的光学声子能量，亟需理论解释。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理声子-自旋弛豫理论（acoustic mode spin-phonon relaxation theory），对声子模式进行从头计算，无需经验拟合参数，直接模拟了与塞曼分裂共振的单声子发射和吸收过程。
AI.result: 定量重现了实验上T1随磁场和温度变化的非单调行为；识别出面外弯曲声子支（二维宿主材料特有的低频声子模式）是导致自旋弛豫的主要来源，该模式产生了独特的低能谱函数。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了二维量子缺陷中心中自旋弛豫的微观物理图像，为理解和优化二维材料中量子传感器的性能提供了理论指导。

title: Decoding magnetic texture
summary: In magnetically ordered materials, magnetic field and temperature variations modify the magnetic texture through their coupling to the local energy landscape, imprinting distinct fingerprints in the resulting magnetic domain patterns. Retrieving these conditions from the pattern remains challenging, as stochastic nucleation and hysteresis produce a nonlinear, multivariate, and ambiguous relationship between magnetic domain morphology and external stimuli. To decode these fingerprints, we designed a controlled magneto-optical inference experiment that reconstructs magnetic field, temperature, and magnetic history from a single fine-scale, high-contrast, pixel-resolved optical polarization map of feature-rich magnetic domain textures in a bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet film. Deep convolutional neural networks are complemented by feature-based neural-network inference using hand-crafted, physically interpretable descriptors of measured magneto-optical image data, linking the decoded information to material-dependent features and exploring their contributions. Together, these results establish magnetic texture as a high-fidelity record of external conditions enabling accurate single image multiparametric sensing and paving the way for data-driven explorations of complex magnetic states. Uncovering the physically interpretable features that encode this record sheds new light on the physics of magnetic domain formation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用深度卷积神经网络和基于物理可解释特征的推理方法，从磁畴纹理的单张高分辨率偏振光学图像中重建出磁场、温度和磁历史，证明磁畴纹理可作为外部条件的高保真记录，实现单图像多参数感知。
AI.motivation: 磁畴纹理与外部条件之间存在非线性、多变量且含滞后的复杂关系，传统方法难以从单张图像中解码这些条件。作者旨在探索能否利用磁畴形态来高精度反推磁场、温度及磁历史。
AI.method: 设计受控磁光推理实验，使用深度卷积神经网络配合基于手工设计、物理可解释描述符的特征推理方法，从铋取代钇铁石榴石薄膜的高对比度像素级偏振光学映射图中提取信息。
AI.result: 成功从单张磁畴图像中高精度重建出磁场、温度和磁历史，验证了磁畴纹理作为外部条件高保真记录的能力。
AI.conclusion: 磁畴纹理可作为高保真记录实现单图像多参数感知，物理可解释特征为理解磁畴形成物理机制提供了新视角。
